name: Animate Fields AOS
description: Adds scroll-triggered animations to field output via third-party formatter settings, using the AOS (Animate On Scroll) JavaScript library.
project_description:
The module allows a site builder to display fields with animations while scrolling down and up. This module utilize the AOS(Animate On Scroll) library. The animation options are available in the Manage Display form for Content Types, Media Types and Block Types.

 Requirements and Dependencies 
 The module depends on the AOS library which is downloaded and installed automatically by the module.

 Links 
 
 AOS Library 
 
 Usage 
 
 Download, install and enable the Animate Fields - AOS module as normal. 
 Got to any Content / Media / Block types → Manage Display and click on the gear icon of the desired field to animate. 
 Click on AOS Animation details options. 
 Check the Display Animations checkbox. 
 Select the animation and its variations to apply. 
 Clear all cache, refresh the page where you expect to see the field and its animation. 
 Enjoy them.
